description: (Na₃InH₂(SO₄)₃)₂H₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3 space group. The structure consists of six H₂ clusters inside a Na₃InH₂(SO₄)₃ framework. In each H₂ cluster, H is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the Na₃InH₂(SO₄)₃ framework, there are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one H and five O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.75 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one H and four O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.61 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.64 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one H and four O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.61 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.53 Å. There are four inequivalent In sites. In the first In site, In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra. All In-O bond lengths are 2.18 Å. In the second In site, In is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. All In-O bond lengths are 2.17 Å. In the third In site, In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.17 Å) and three longer (2.18 Å) In-O bond lengths. In the fourth In site, In is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. All In-O bond lengths are 2.19 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na atoms. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na atom. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-55°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.54 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-50°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.56 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-54°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.54 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one In, and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂InS trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one In and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one In and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one In and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom.
